text:
Maria Lopez: Quick heads-up — DevTool blog is scheduled to go live tomorrow 10:00 AM PT. Need a tight owned-channel + social amplification plan. Minimal scope: hero tweet, LinkedIn post, product changelog entry, community post (Discord/Forum), translations (ES/FR), sales one-pager, and a small influencer outreach list. Who can take what?
Samir Patel: I can own hero tweet + LinkedIn copy. Will draft once I have final headline + permalink.
Evan Chen: I'll do changelog + one-pager for sales. Need 3x bullet highlights and any hard numbers by 8:00 AM PT.
Courtney Blake: I can handle ES/FR translations — ETA 9:00 AM PT. Do you also want JP localization?
Maria Lopez: Not for this drop, Courtney — keep JP flagged for next sprint.
Jena (publish-bot): Reminder: scheduled publish job set for 2026-06-16 17:00:00 UTC (10:00 AM PT). Draft URL: https://blog.redwood.inference/devtool-release (placeholder).
Samir Patel: For social, propose we prepare 2 tweet variants (short, and a 2-line card version) + 1 LinkedIn long-form. Also need a featured image from design — @Design Bot can you confirm availability? :rocket: 
Design Bot: Asset slot confirmed. Can produce 1200x628 hero and a square thumbnail by 6:00 AM PT tomorrow if copy is final.
Evan Chen: Numbers from eng — latency improvement: up to 30% (depends on batch/seq). Throughput uplift ~1.4x in our lab tests. Use conservative phrasing: "up to 30%" and link to benchmark doc.
Samir Patel: Okay using "up to 30%". Drafting now. Quick ask: UTMs for links? Marketing wants utm_source=twitter|linkedin etc.
Maria Lopez: Yes — use utm_source=owned_social, utm_campaign=devtool_launch, utm_medium={channel}. Samir, please apply.
Samir Patel: Draft tweets below — feedback welcome.
Samir Patel: ```
Variant A (short): Ship faster with Redwood DevTool — up to 30% lower inference latency and better throughput. Blog + benchmarks → https://blog.redwood.inference/devtool-release?utm_source=twitter&utm_campaign=devtool_launch&utm_medium=tweet
Variant B (card): Ship faster. Run models cheaper. Redwood DevTool cuts inference latency by up to 30% and boosts throughput — hands-on breakdown in our new blog. [link with UTMs]
```
Courtney Blake: Translations noted. I'll localize both variants and the LinkedIn post. Will preserve metric phrasing and keep "up to 30%" literal in ES/FR.
Evan Chen: One-pager bullets for sales (rough):
- What: DevTool — inference toolchain optimizations for production workloads.
- Why it matters: reduces median latency, increases throughput, lowers per-token cost.
- Key wins: up to 30% latency reduction, ~1.4x throughput in internal tests, works with hosted/dedicated/private deployments.
- CTA: Try the hosted API or request a Dedicated trial.
Maria Lopez: Looks good. Evan, please add 2-3 customer-facing example use-cases and a short quote from product.
Evan Chen: Will add. Need a product quote — @Maria can you share one or should I pull from the PR deck?
Maria Lopez: Use this: "DevTool gives engineering teams predictable, production-grade performance — without rewrites." Short and usable.
Samir Patel: LinkedIn draft (long-form) posted below — please scan for tone.
Samir Patel: ```
LinkedIn (long): Today we’re announcing Redwood DevTool — a set of production-ready inference optimizations that help teams ship faster and reduce infrastructure costs. In our tests, DevTool delivers up to 30% latency reduction and improves throughput, while working across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments. Read more and see the benchmarks. [link] #RedwoodInference #MLInfra
```
Courtney Blake: Minor grammar tweak suggestion for FR copy — I’ll DM the change.
Maria Lopez: Outreach: small list of 6 influencers + 4 partners to ping at publish time. Can someone own quick outreach? Want messages to be personalized and include the TL;DR + link to blog + offer for a quick demo.
Evan Chen: I can draft outreach templates. Samir can send from the company account or we can route through Partnerships if partner-specific.
Samir Patel: I’ll send the influencer pings via company handle. Evan, please DM templates.
Design Bot: Final note: hero image will include a small "up to 30%" stat badge if copy approved. Confirm?
Maria Lopez: Confirmed. Keep badge small and non-clickbait.
Jena (publish-bot): After publish, I will post to #announcements with the same short summary. Ensure that channel copy is ready.
Samir Patel: I'll prepare #announcements copy. Draft: "New: Redwood DevTool — up to 30% lower inference latency. Blog + benchmarks: [link]"
Maria Lopez: Perfect. Last check: approvals. Product + Legal need to sign off by 7:30 AM PT. Evan, can you chase?
Evan Chen: On it — will ping Product and Legal now.
Courtney Blake: Translation files will be in the shared folder: /marketing/localization/devtool_launch/ by 9:00 AM PT.
Maria Lopez: Awesome team — thanks. If anything slips, flag here ASAP. :heart:
